scopeBasis: Provided chapter plan, textbook sections and teacher deck. The original course scope is preserved through the listed lessons.
officialCodeStatus: Not independently verified against a retrievable current official outcome register. No outcome codes have been invented. Confirm code-level mapping during division/Codex acceptance.

lessons.title: Genes, alleles, genotype and phenotype
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish a gene from an allele, genotype from phenotype, and homozygous from heterozygous combinations.

lessons.title: Mendel’s experiments and segregation
lessons.learningGoal: Use P, F1 and F2 crosses to explain segregation of alleles without blending or loss of a recessive allele.

lessons.title: Single-trait crosses and probability
lessons.learningGoal: Construct and interpret a monohybrid Punnett square, distinguish genotype and phenotype probabilities, and state the denominator.

lessons.title: Test crosses and unknown genotypes
lessons.learningGoal: Use a homozygous recessive tester to distinguish possible parental genotypes and explain uncertainty from small samples.

lessons.title: Two-trait crosses and independent assortment
lessons.learningGoal: List valid gametes for two loci, use a Punnett square or product rule, and identify the assumption of independent assortment.

lessons.title: Incomplete dominance and codominance
lessons.learningGoal: Compare incomplete dominance and codominance while preserving ordinary allele segregation.

lessons.title: Multiple alleles and ABO blood groups
lessons.learningGoal: Use the ABO model to distinguish population allele diversity from individual genotype and solve blood-group crosses.

lessons.title: Sex-linked inheritance
lessons.learningGoal: Use a typical XX/XY model to solve X-linked crosses and distinguish conditional from joint probabilities.

lessons.title: Polygenic traits and environmental influences
lessons.learningGoal: Explain polygenic and environmental contributions, and distinguish genotype, gene expression and measured phenotype.

lessons.title: Reading autosomal pedigrees
lessons.learningGoal: Read pedigree symbols and generations, infer autosomal genotypes under a stated model, and preserve unresolved alternatives.

lessons.title: Sex-linked pedigrees and testing a model
lessons.learningGoal: Use chromosome transmission to evaluate X-linked models and distinguish consistency from proof in small pedigrees.

lessons.title: Linked genes and recombinant offspring
lessons.learningGoal: Identify linked allele arrangements, parental and recombinant combinations, and use a test cross to interpret gamete frequencies.

lessons.title: Recombination frequency and chromosome maps
lessons.learningGoal: Calculate recombination frequency, construct simple maps and distinguish map distance from a universal physical base-pair distance.

lessons.title: Genetic testing, counselling and decisions
lessons.learningGoal: Distinguish a genetic test result from a guaranteed phenotype, and identify consent, uncertainty and privacy considerations.
